official_task_documentation.description: There is a basket containing multiple slices of bread and a toaster. The robot needs to pick up two slices one by one, place them into the toaster, and then press the lever down to start toasting.

scoring.condition: No bread slice is inserted into a toaster slot.
One bread slice is inserted into a toaster slot and all bread axes satisfy the required orientation.
Two bread slices are inserted into the toaster slots and all bread axes satisfy the required orientation.
Both toaster slots are filled, exactly two bread slices remain on the shelf, the toaster control is pressed down, and the robot returns to origin.
